parameters.name: Id
parameters.description: The task ID. You can obtain the task ID from the ID field in the response of the CreateScanTask or ScanOssObjectV1 operation.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the request and response. Default value: **zh_cn**. Valid values:
- **zh_cn**: Simplified Chinese.
- **en_us**: English (US).
